tagline: A quieter way to work with PDFs
hero: One PDF. Every document in its place.
intro: Split documents, name them from the page, and save a tidy ZIP. Your PDF is processed in this browser.
free: Free demo · export up to 3 input pages
limit: Up to 20 PDFs at once. Each up to 50 MB and 300 pages.
empty: Your page preview will appear here.
rangeHint: Include every page exactly once, in original order.
drawHint: Drag a box over text in the preview. Areas use the same relative position on every page.
carry: Append pages with an empty ID to the previous document
carryHint: The first page must have an ID. A repeated ID after a different ID starts a new document.
patternHint: {name} selected name · {key} document ID · {index} sequence · {original} input filename. Name and ID come from each document's first page.
templateHint: Rules are saved as a JSON file on your device. PDF text and PDF files are not included.
resultsEmpty: Check the proposed page ranges and filenames before downloading.
verified: All pages are included once, in the original order.
changed: Rules changed. Run the preview again.
ready: Ready. Review the list, then download.
done: ZIP prepared. Check your browser's downloads.
selecting: Draw a box on the page. Press Escape to cancel.
loaded: Rules loaded. Review the areas on your document.
invalidPdf: This file could not be opened as a PDF. Try exporting a new PDF from the original application.
encrypted: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Open an authorized, unprotected copy.
interactive: Embedded files, media and active PDF actions are not supported. Use an ordinary static PDF copy; keep your original.
tooLarge: This release supports files up to 50 MB and 300 pages.
noText: No usable text was found in the selected area. Scans need OCR first, or use page-count splitting and manual filenames.
missingKey: The document ID is missing on page {page}. Adjust the area or the empty-ID option.
missingName: Filename text is missing on page {page}. Adjust the area or use {index} instead.
areaRequired: Select the document ID area first.
nameRequired: Select a filename text area, or remove {name} from the pattern.
badPattern: Use a nonempty filename pattern with only these fields: {name}, {key}, {index}, {original}.
badRanges: Ranges must cover all pages exactly once, in order, with no gaps or overlaps.
badCount: Enter a whole number from 1 to the total page count.
badTemplate: This rules file is not valid for Paperlane. Export a new rules file from this app.
outputError: Output verification failed. Nothing was saved for this step. Try a smaller static PDF.
genericError: The operation failed. Clear the document and try again. Your original file has not been changed.
help: Answers before you need to ask
faq1q: Does my PDF leave this device?
faq1a: PDF processing runs locally in your browser. This app does not upload your document or its text. The hosting provider still handles normal page requests. No analytics or advertising scripts are included.
faq2a: Static PDFs and fillable forms can be split by page count or explicit ranges. Form fields are fixed into the page exactly as they appear. Text-based splitting and naming require extractable text. Scans and handwriting are not OCR-processed. Signed PDFs and dynamic (XFA) forms are not supported.
faq3a: Draw the ID area on a representative page. Consecutive pages with the same ID stay together. Draw a second area for the filename. Review every result, especially when page layouts vary. Different regions or identical IDs can cause incorrect grouping.
faq4q: Are the original and the output identical?
faq4a: The original file stays unchanged. Output pages are copied into new PDFs. Page appearance is intended to be preserved; document-level bookmarks, metadata, links between pages and accessibility tags may change or be lost. Keep the original and check your outputs.
faq5q: Do I need an account or a subscription?
faq5a: The browser demo is free. The Windows version is a separate one-time purchase. Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked. Your downloaded version does not expire. Future major versions and personalized document setup are not included.
faq6a: Characters unsafe for common file systems are replaced. Long names are shortened, and duplicates receive a numbered suffix. Edit any proposed filename before saving. Every save includes manifest.json with the final page-to-file mapping.
diagnosticsHint: Includes app version, browser, error code and page count only. No PDF, extracted text or filenames.
privacyNote: Keep the original. Check the preview. Save with confidence in what you have reviewed.
adjusted: Unsafe or duplicate filenames were adjusted. Review the final names below.
loadingFailed: The app could not load its required files. Reload this page while connected, or use the full local package.
someSkipped: {count} file(s) could not be added. The other files are ready.
filesOpened: {files} PDFs opened. Draw areas on any of them; the same rules apply to every file.
tooMany: Too many files at once. Use up to 20 PDFs, 200 MB and 2,000 pages in total.
duplicateFile: This file is already in the list.
signed: Digitally signed PDFs are not supported, because splitting would break the signature. Keep the signed original.
xfa: Dynamic (XFA) forms are not supported. Print the form to PDF first (for example with Microsoft Print to PDF), then open that copy.
formAppearance: Some form fields in this PDF have no saved appearance, so their values could be lost. Open it in a PDF viewer, print it to PDF, then open that copy.
batchProblem: {count} file(s) need attention. Adjust the rules or remove those files, then preview again.
folderHint: Creates a new folder inside the folder you choose. Existing files are never overwritten.
folderDone: Saved {count} files to the new folder “{folder}”.
folderCancelled: Folder selection was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
folderError: Could not write to that folder. Choose another folder or download a ZIP instead.
partialFolder: {count} file(s) were already written to “{folder}”. Check or delete that folder before trying again.
faq7q: Can I process several PDFs at once?
faq7a: Yes. Open up to 20 PDFs together. The same rules apply to every file, and each file gets its own subfolder. Draw areas on a representative file and check every result before saving.
tooMuchTotal: Adding this file would exceed the batch limit of 200 MB and 2,000 pages in total. Open it in a separate batch.
type3Warning: Check the names carefully: {files} uses a font whose text may not be fully readable, so document IDs or names can be incomplete.
demoLimit: The free demo exports files with up to 3 total input pages. Your original is unchanged. Use the built-in sample to test larger groups, or check the Windows version.
